Strategy: Wide relative dead-zone avoidance. Exact fits score highest; post-placement residuals below half the item score far lower, while larger residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit would leave a residual below half the item while a looser bin leaves more. It may help by avoiding small leftovers relative to the current item scale, but may fail if later items are much smaller than the current one.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - 200.0 if r - item < item / 2 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Wide relative dead-zone avoidance: penalize residual in (0, item/2) by 200, exact fit highest.
